description: García-Alén, Gonzalo and colleagues publish this resource through the source community. The collection supports two-dimensional non-hydrostatic flow-model calibration around hydraulic structures. Nine weir geometries were tested in a 15-metre flume with 0.5-by 0.5-metre cross-section, each under free and submerged discharge conditions. Coverage includes water-depth grids of about 125 points, with inflow close to 30 L/s and differing downstream levels. Raw and processed measurements, geometry descriptions and supporting Matlab processing scripts form one experimental bundle. The source recommends processed results for model calibration and discharge-rating analysis. Zenodo supplies the deposited data and native file inventory with open access under cc-by-4.0. Sample values, linked files and code were not read or executed during source checks. A limitation is that complete implementation or measurement settings cannot be reconstructed from descriptive metadata alone. Related experimental components and publications retain their distinct roles; separate deposits are not assumed to provide independent observations.
